title: MedEthicsQA: A Comprehensive Question Answering Benchmark for Medical Ethics Evaluation of LLMs
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. Findings are focused on the general performance of models on medical ethics questions, which include scenarios involving physicians' personal or religious beliefs. The overall finding is that medical-specific fine-tuning can degrade performance on ethics questions compared to foundation models.
